summary: Frontend-only testing of /claridad redesign (architectural palette + semáforo KPIs + Trayectoria logic). All 6 requested behaviors verified successfully via Playwright on production URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: cleanup effect resets 'convocada' when modo changes, but changing modo also sets resultado=null, so trayectoria is hidden anyway (behavior is correct, code is a bit redundant).

Minor UX: preset buttons (3x3px dots) and modo toggle dots (3.5x3.5px) are very small targets — intentional per 100% graphical spec, but a11y-wise they may be hard to hit; ARIA labels present so acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PantallaClaridad passes all spec checks: (1) /claridad loads, header rgb(169,78,52)=brick, no JS errors; (2) ASESORIA + nominal + evaluar shows estado-general-disc, 7 kpi-dot-*, convocar-trayectoria-btn, and trayectoria-texto is absent from DOM until click; (3) after clicking convocar-trayectoria-btn, trayectoria-texto with trayectoria-nombre appears ('Mantener vector de estado nominal'); (4) autoengaño preset produces mixed VERDE/AMARILLO/ROJO dot colors matching palette (grass #4E7A34, amber #E0A82E, red #C0392B); (5) AGENCIA + autoengaño triggers requiere_cenit=true and trayectoria-texto renders AUTOMATICALLY without clicking, with brick background rgb(169,78,52) and label 'CÉNIT · TRAYECTORIA', plus barra-hermanos with hermano-corto/mediano/largo colored bars visible; (6) resultado-panel contains NO KPI names or numbers — only shapes/colors, and the single data text is the Trayectoria.
